faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Roorkee Project Associate position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Project Associate position at IIT Roorkee is 31 August 2026. It is advisable to complete the application process well before this deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Associate role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's degree in Engineering/Architecture/Planning along with a Master's degree in Geomatics, Geospatial Engineering, Geoinformatics, Remote Sensing, or similar fields. An excellent academic record is also a prerequisite.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, according to the provided information, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Associate position will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 35,000, plus applicable House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q5. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the post of Project Associate in this recruitment drive by IIT Roorkee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Project Associate role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Associate position at IIT Roorkee will primarily involve an Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any age limit for applying to this post?
faq.answer: The provided data does not specify any minimum or maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Project Associate position.

faq.question: Q8. What is the nature of the job?
faq.answer: The job for the Project Associate position at IIT Roorkee is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the job location?
faq.answer: The job location for this recruitment is Roorkee, Uttarakhand.

faq.question: Q10. How can I apply for the Project Associate position?
faq.answer: You can apply online through the official website of IIT Roorkee or via the direct application link provided in the 'Important Links' section before the last date of 31 August 2026.
